title: The Drumstick and a Wooden Spoon
youtube_title: The Drumstick and a Wooden Spoon | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Zola sees that an one drum and a wooden spoon that could be a second beater will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Zola makes a smaller, even share so Maude is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
